authorization.sentence: I authorize the three region-repair rescue arms -- configs/t4_region_repair_rescue_braf_d06_v1.json at payload sha256 7ec9cc6a684cf41b78a405cb6e6e1d1ad4ecaf5c708328623687c4a9166c69f4, configs/t4_region_repair_rescue_fa7_d06_v1.json at bbc6b3766f1687dd9376e00150acab66ac696def657a3d08034b8206aac1f38d, and configs/t4_region_repair_rescue_fa7_d04_v1.json at c9b85fec7b156e50adb4fba32db1d60e30ea9ef6ba0b1a2fb76c9d1dac3accf3 -- to charge up to 1241 oracle calls in total, at the per-cell ceilings 248/248/248/248/249, as a versioned region-repair rescue built on wiring commit 2397522f over repair commit 7210f666, accepting that fa7_0's 248 calls are a bounded reseed rather than a mechanism-backed rescue, and that these results must be reported as a named rescue phase and never spliced into the unchanged-v1 panel table.

ceiling_derivation.finding: every prior attempt on these cells charged exactly 1 call and terminated at status=candidate_exhaustion in round 0
ceiling_derivation.rule: 250 authorized per cell minus measured lifetime charged calls

payload.claim_boundary: SEPARATE, VERSIONED REGION-REPAIR RESCUE. Run under its own contract identity, app and volume, at a per-cell ceiling below the arm's 250, with a proposal law that DIFFERS from the v1 arm it would be compared against. It must never be spliced into the unchanged-v1 250-call panel table without being named as a rescue. The mechanism is scoped to the LARGE-EXCISION pool: it neither reaches nor suppresses the micro (plus or minus one atom) pool, so for a cell whose only in-ball rescue is a one-atom edit this changes nothing and takes nothing away. OWNER DECISION 2026-09-20: fa7_0's 248-call allocation in this arm is a BOUNDED RESEED, not a mechanism-backed rescue. Measured on the campaign path under the production kernel (120 shallow draws, matched seed, 0 oracle calls), fa7_0 scores OFF 0 -> ON 0 under the region law, while fa7_2 in this same arm scores 0 -> 4. fa7_0 also has ZERO one-module eligible children even under the repair. Its calls are therefore spent on a fresh seed over a search that failed marginally before, which is a legitimate but speculative use of budget. NO fa7_0 improvement may be attributed to the region law unless later evidence supports that attribution specifically.

exclusions_carried_forward.5ht1b_2: excluded on mechanism, not on failure: its witnesses need a different region SHAPE (two-boundary interior excision plus one reattachment bond) which the law does not draw, and the production executor's charge policy refuses 9 of 16 pendant regions on that source with zero refusals on every neutral cell; bond_insert is outside the frozen Active8 codec surface so reattachment would have to be cycle_close

exclusions_carried_forward.protonation: no protonation or charge-state edit enters this rescue; the protonation route is a separate configuration and mixing it would make the mechanism unattributable

region_law_declaration.ASSERTION: THIS FIELD IS LOAD-BEARING. If it is absent the rescue runs law=None, which is v1 byte-identical, and the whole budget is spent reproducing the same candidate exhaustion. Its presence under proposal.shallow is the difference between the rescue and a repeat of the failure it exists to fix
region_law_declaration.absent_means: law=None, v1 byte-identical for every non-opted-in caller
region_law_declaration.consumption_check: assert_region_law_is_consumed runs the production proposal path until the draw site consults a probe, so a signed field that nothing reads fails closed
region_law_declaration.must_not_appear_elsewhere: assert_no_unconsumable_region_law_request raises on every proposal worker if region_law is declared at the top level or under any lane other than shallow, because only shallow reaches a synthesizer that threads it
region_law_declaration.verified_field_surface: region_law_contract.CONTRACT_FIELD == 'region_law' and CONTRACT_LANE == 'shallow', read from the merged source, not from a message

reported_ivg_source.evidence: published lead-optimization table, not a recomputation from released per-seed CSV rows
reported_ivg_source.known_upstream_discrepancy: the released CSV-derived run means differ from the published README table; headline comparison uses the published table and records the discrepancy rather than silently substituting the recomputation
